_note: Unit sub-types, for keyword targeting later (e.g. "Give all your Animals +1 Attack and +1 Health"). Only applies to Unit cards (type: "unit") — Spells and duration-based Support cards don't get a unitType. Add more here anytime; card_editor.html picks up new entries automatically, same as keywords.json/factions.json.

Human.description: Ordinary people — soldiers, crafters, scouts, cooks.

Animal.description: Non-sapient creatures — beasts, wildlife, tamed or wild.

Construct.description: Man-made or magically animated beings — golems, mechanisms, wards.

Elemental.description: Raw magical force given temporary form — fire, water, air, and earth spirits. Not golems (those are Construct) and not creatures merely themed around an element, like dragons (see Dragon).

Dragon.description: A true draconic creature/lineage, even if elementally themed (e.g. a fire-breathing whelp) — distinct from Elemental, which is a manifestation of raw element rather than a living species.
